svg.title: Multiple phone providers: a controlled primary-to-secondary flow
svg.desc: After Easy Auth and decryption, evaluation returns without a provider call. Live delivery uses shared durable operation state and an isolated OAuth context for the primary account. Acceptance returns success. Blocks, invalid requests, and uncertain outcomes stop. Only verified nonacceptance or an eligible pre-dispatch failure can pass policy, remaining-time, and reservation checks for one secondary attempt. Each account keeps its own OAuth context.
svg.metadata: Microsoft Azure and Entra architecture icons used for documentation under their permitted-use terms: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ and https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/architecture-icons . Product artwork is embedded unchanged.
svg.text: One primary attempt, one controlled secondary attempt
Keep account credentials separate. Use the secondary only when the primary is known not to have accepted.
Evaluation ends before provider credentials or sending.
Own token tenant, scope, and identity
Block, invalid request, timeout, lost response,
or unknown outcome. Investigate uncertain delivery.
Own OAuth context and configured channel URL
